L211: # Agentic Mobile
L212: 
L213: An open standard for AI agents to orchestrate mobile in-app advertising workflows.
L214: ## Overview
L215: 
L216: Agentic Mobile enables AI agents to discover, configure, and optimize mobile advertising supply and demand. Built for the agentic era, it provides standardized interfaces for programmatic communication between intelligent agents and mobile advertising platforms.
L217: 
L218: Multi-Protocol Support:
L219:   * MCP (Model Context Protocol) - Direct AI assistant integration via stdio or HTTP
L220:   * A2A (Agent2Agent Protocol) - Agent-to-agent workflows with task management
L221:   * REST API - Traditional integrations (planned)
L222: ### Why Agentic Mobile?
L223: 
L224: Mobile in-app advertising has unique requirements:
L225: 
L226:   * SDK-based environments with initialization and configuration needs
L227:   * Real-time auction dynamics with sub-200ms latency requirements
L228:   * Platform-specific privacy (ATT, Privacy Sandbox, SKAdNetwork)
L229:   * Complex mediation across multiple ad networks
L230:   * Gradual rollouts tied to app release cycles
L231: 
L232: Agentic Mobile addresses these with a protocol designed specifically for mobile.
